senses.gloss: (or חִיפָּה) f. (חפף I, חוף) ḥefa (or ḥippa) a skin which has been salted, but has not gone through the consecutive stages of tanning with flour and gall-nut.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 79a:9">Sabb. 79ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 22a:15">Gitt. 22ᵃ</cite>. Sifra Sh’mini, Sh’ratsim, ch. VII, Par. 6 <he>עור האֵיפָה</he>.
